_comment: Mutation testing for the SECURITY-CRITICAL libs only (access control, download-token signing, citation extraction + verification, the SSRF private-IP guard). These are the modules where a test suite that merely *executes* lines without *asserting* behavior is dangerous, so we pay the mutation-testing cost here and nowhere else. Run on demand via `npm run test:mutation`, and monthly via mutation.yml's cron.
comment_tsconfigFile_comment: Deliberately points at a file that does not exist. Stryker's sandbox rewrites tsconfig 'extends'/'references' paths using ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson, an API TypeScript 7 removed — with a real tsconfig here, stryker crashes before it mutates anything. backend/tsconfig.json has no 'extends' and no 'references', and its include/exclude globs are all sandbox-relative, so the rewrite it skips is a no-op for this project. Delete this key if stryker ever stops touching tsconfig.
comment_ignoreStatic_comment: Module-load-time mutants (e.g. the BlockList subnet tables in privateIp.ts) cannot be toggled by Stryker's mutation switching and would survive spuriously; runtime behavior of those tables is asserted by privateIp.test.ts instead. Floors only go up: when tests kill more mutants, raise thresholds.break in the same PR. Widen mutate only alongside tests that keep the score above the floor.
